---
name: "nf-core/fastq_subsample_fq_salmon"
description: "Subsample fastq"
keywords:
- "fastq"
- "subsample"
- "strandedness"
components:
- "fq/subsample"
- "salmon/quant"
- "salmon/index"
input:
- ch_reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "List of input FastQ files of size 1 and 2 for single-end and paired-end\
      \ data,\nrespectively.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(reads) ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- ch_genome_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Genome sequence in fasta format.\n\nStructure: [ path(fasta) ]\n"
- ch_transcript_fasta:
    type: "file"
    description: "Transcript sequence in fasta format.\n\nStructure: [ path(fasta)\
      \ ]\n"
- ch_gtf:
    type: "file"
    description: "Genome features in GTF format.\n\nStructure: [ path(gtf) ]\n"
- ch_index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing the Salmon index.\n\nStructure: [ path(index)\
      \ ]\n"
- make_index:
    type: "boolean"
    description: "Whether to create salmon index before running salmon quant"
output:
- index:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Directory containing the Salmon index, either the one supplied as\
      \ input or\nthe one built by this subworkflow.\n\nStructure: [ path(index) ]\n"
- reads:
    type: "file"
    description: "Subsampled FastQ reads.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), [ path(fastq)\
      \ ] ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fq,fastq}{,.gz}"
- results:
    type: "directory"
    description: "Folder containing the quantification results for a specific sample.\n\
      \nStructure: [ val(meta), path(results) ]\n"
- json_info:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing meta information from Salmon quant,\nwhich could\
      \ be used to infer strandedness among other things.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(json) ]\n"
    pattern: "*info.json"
- lib_format_counts:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing the library format counts.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(json) ]\n"
    pattern: "*lib_format_counts.json"
authors:
- "@robsyme"
- "@drpatelh"
maintainers:
- "@robsyme"
- "@drpatelh"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/salmon/index@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/fq/subsample@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/salmon/quant@0.0.0-6d1763b"
